title: Bettersize Instruments
content: Bettersize Instruments is a China-based laboratory instrumentation company focused on particle size, particle shape, density, zeta potential, and powder characterization systems. These capabilities are relevant to aerogel precursor, powder, and particulate materials analysis in R&D and quality-control workflows. Bettersize is a practical Equipment Materials listing for teams building upstream characterization capability in Asia.
review_notes: Directory profile reviewed for listing quality, category fit, and current public website availability.
